publication: Clowney et al. 2015, eLife; Kallman et al. 2015, eLife; Pavlou & Goodwin 2013 (pathway identity)

completeness: ILLUSTRATIVE SUBSET ONLY: 9 cell types of the male courtship decision pathway, unweighted qualitative edges with E/I sign. NOT measured connectivity and NOT monosynaptic proof (functional convergence per Clowney 2015).
limitations: Pathway-level only; intermediate neurons omitted; sim dynamics are model choices, not measurements. Dimorphism flags cite the stated sources per node.

nodes.function: ppk25+ foreleg sensory; detects female pheromone 7,11-HD (Clowney 2015)
ppk23+ F cells; female-pheromone sensory, activate P1 (Kallman 2015)
ppk23+ M cells; male-pheromone sensory, drive mAL (Kallman 2015)
Gr32a sensory; detects male pheromone 7-T, converges on mAL (review)
Or67d olfactory; detects male pheromone cVA, parallel route to P1 (review)
ascending excitatory relay, female-pheromone selective; feminization alters connectivity (Clowney 2015)
GABAergic, ~30 male vs ~5 female cells; gain control on P1 (Kimura 2005; Kallman 2015)
male-specific courtship command (~30 cells); excitation triggers sustained courtship (Kohatsu 2011)
courtship relay P1>dendrites superimposed; descending to thoracic motor (review)
